HISTORY AND CITIZENSHIP — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #6
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: HISTORY AND CITIZENSHIP
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Destroying road signs
   B. Littering in markets
   C. Obeying laws and caring for public property
   D. Avoiding all community work

2. Which statement about Colonization of Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Colonization of Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Treat Colonization of Africa as rumours only.
   C. Say Colonization of Africa never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Colonization of Africa.

3. Which statement about Political and Constitutional developments and challenges since Independence is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Political and Constitutional developments and challenges since Independence as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Political and Constitutional developments and challenges since Independence.
   C. Explain Political and Constitutional developments and challenges since Independence with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Say Political and Constitutional developments and challenges since Independence never happens in Kenya.

4. Which statement about Introduction to History and Citizenship is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Introduction to History and Citizenship never happens in Kenya.
   B. Explain Introduction to History and Citizenship with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Introduction to History and Citizenship.
   D. Treat Introduction to History and Citizenship as rumours only.

5. Which statement about National integration is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain National integration with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing National integration.
   C. Say National integration never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat National integration as rumours only.

6. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Measure rainfall only
   B. Replace the compass rose
   C. Explain symbols used on a map
   D. Name the president

7. Which statement about Human Developments in Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Human Developments in Africa.
   B. Say Human Developments in Africa never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Human Developments in Africa as rumours only.
   D. Explain Human Developments in Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

8. Which statement about African Civilisations up to 19th Century is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say African Civilisations up to 19th Century never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat African Civilisations up to 19th Century as rumours only.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing African Civilisations up to 19th Century.
   D. Explain African Civilisations up to 19th Century with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

9. Which statement about Modern Nationalism in Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Modern Nationalism in Africa never happens in Kenya.
   B. Explain Modern Nationalism in Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Modern Nationalism in Africa as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Modern Nationalism in Africa.

10. Which statement about Establishment of colonial rule is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Establishment of colonial rule.
   B. Say Establishment of colonial rule never happens in Kenya.
   C. Explain Establishment of colonial rule with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Treat Establishment of colonial rule as rumours only.

11. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Nairobi
   B. Kisumu
   C. Nakuru
   D. Mombasa

12. Which statement about Global Wars is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Global Wars.
   B. Explain Global Wars with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Global Wars as rumours only.
   D. Say Global Wars never happens in Kenya.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Modern Slavery and Servitude and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Global governance 3.5 1st Generation of industrial revolution in Europe and Afri and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Global Governance and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain The 1st Generation of Industrial Revolution and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
